themes_detail.label: Panhandling surge in Sunnyside
themes_detail.summary: Panhandling complaints spiked to 4 reports THIS WEEK, a 1500% increase over the 8-week average of 0.2 weekly complaints (z-score: 8.66), signaling a potential new street-level safety or social services concern in the district.
evidence: 4 panhandling complaints THIS WEEK vs 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 8.66 indicates statistically significant anomaly
First major spike in this complaint category in recent tracking period
reporting_angles: Interview residents and local business owners on 46th Ave and Queens Boulevard about increased street activity
Contact NYPD and outreach organizations to understand if this reflects a service gap or emerging encampment trend

themes_detail.label: Litter basket shortage explodes
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests jumped to 5 complaints THIS WEEK, a 3900% spike over the 8-week average of 0.1 weekly complaints (z-score: 14.74), suggesting residents are unable to dispose of trash and public sanitation infrastructure is critically inadequate.
evidence: 5 litter basket requests THIS WEEK vs 0.1 weekly average (z-score: 14.74)
Highest severity spike in entire dataset by magnitude
Concurrent with 28 illegal dumping complaints last week (220% above baseline)
reporting_angles: Map 311 complaints to identify which blocks are requesting baskets and verify sanitation gaps with photographic evidence
Interview DSNY about maintenance schedules and recent deinstallations that may have triggered demand surge

themes_detail.label: Illegal dumping surge intensifies
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints reached 28 LAST WEEK, a 220% increase over the 8-week baseline of 8.8 weekly complaints (z-score: 5.4), suggesting coordinated refuse disposal or property maintenance neglect across multiple sites in the district.
evidence: 28 illegal dumping complaints last week vs 8.8 weekly average (220% increase)
Overlaps with litter basket spike, suggesting broader waste management breakdown
reporting_angles: Geomaps illegal dumping complaints to identify hotspots—likely industrial sites, vacant lots, or curb areas near demolition work
Investigate whether the 15 full demolitions and 101 new building projects filed in last 90 days are generating construction waste improperly stored

themes_detail.label: Curb condition deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints jumped to 8 LAST WEEK, a 327% spike over the 8-week average of 1.9 weekly complaints (z-score: 4.83), indicating accelerating damage to streetscape infrastructure that may correlate with heavy construction activity in the district.
evidence: 8 curb condition complaints last week vs 1.9 weekly average (327% increase)
682 DOB permits filed in last 90 days, including 15 demolitions—likely construction traffic damaging curbs
reporting_angles: Cross-reference curb complaints with active demolition and new building sites to determine causation
Request DOB inspection data on street damage responsibility and contractor bonding compliance

themes_detail.label: Food safety complaints rising
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints nearly doubled to 7 LAST WEEK, a 133% increase over the 8-week average of 3.0 weekly complaints (z-score: 3.58), suggesting emerging health code violations or inspection gaps in restaurants and food vendors.
evidence: 7 food establishment complaints last week vs 3.0 weekly average (133% increase)
Z-score of 3.58 indicates moderate statistical significance
Outdoor dining complaints also spiked 2 weeks ago (967% above baseline), suggesting possible overlap with temporary dining setups
reporting_angles: Obtain DOHMH inspection reports for Sunnyside/Woodside to identify specific violations and repeat violators
Interview Health Department about whether outdoor dining expansion (noted in data) is straining inspection capacity
